_comment: Parallel lanes as VS Code INTEGRATED-TERMINAL tabs. Cmd+Shift+P -> Tasks: Run Task -> pick a lane, or 'Lanes 0-1: open all' to spawn both. Each opens a dedicated terminal already inside that lane's worktree and starts a CLEAN Claude session there. Also available from any terminal as `ob 0` / `ob 1` (shell function in ~/.zshrc). REWRITTEN 2026-08-05: these tasks used to launch a continuous autonomous build loop whose briefing named scripts/lane.sh, .remember/LANE.md and docs/planning/feature-dashboard.md. All three of those were deleted from the repo, so the task started a lane that had no claim ledger to claim from, no board to pick work off, and no briefing to read - it looked like it launched and then had nothing to do. The loop is recoverable from git history if it is ever wanted back; a task that silently launches a broken one is not worth keeping in the meantime. The lanes themselves are real worktrees sharing Supaprod/.git, so each costs only its working tree. To add one: git worktree add ../cadence-lane-N -b parallel/lane-N, then copy a block below. See docs/operations/parallel-build.md.
